items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then ACTIVE vs Cowboys; post-game said hamstring came out great, back issue won't keep him out.
items.why: Official active; self-reported hamstring/back fine after gutsy efficient game.
items.implication: RB1 back on track ROS; no extended absence.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM in weekend summary then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; Schefter/Rapoport corroborated pregame.
items.why: Rams optimistic Saturday, no setbacks, felt better; official active list.
items.implication: WR1 lock with Adams out; full target volume expected.
items.opportunity: Primary routes/targets in depleted WR room.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then INACTIVE (Schefter actives list); quad injury limited practice path.
items.why: Pessimistic reports and limited practice; official inactive.
items.implication: Misses another week; committee continues without him.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide, no lasting concern indicated.
items.implication: No missed time expected; RB1 continues.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle) in ETR weekend summary after limited practice.
items.why: Official out after missing prior games; limited all week.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Flowers/others downgraded without Lamar.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) per ETR weekend injury summary.
items.implication: Eagles WR room thinned; targets to others.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT alongside DeVonta Smith in ETR OUT list.
items.why: Did not practice Friday; grouped in OUT.
items.implication: Further depletes PHI receivers for MNF.
items.opportunity: Slot/role expansion for backups like Lemon.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play; Schefter confirmed activation.
items.why: Activated off IR; full participant path.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role for Packers.

items.text: Berry calls to put respect on Tee Higgins' name after strong performance.
items.why: Consistent production warrants higher regard/start consideration.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPG via 9 carries inside-5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Goal-line and receiving work overrides inefficiency.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex floor despite poor rushing metrics.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries + target lead = high TD/PPR upside.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry advises turning big game into sell-high opportunity.
items.why: One big game after inconsistent usage; capitalize on peak value.
items.implication: Trade for more consistent asset; not buy into spike.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024 (limited).
items.why: Collins dominant share; Dell ramping slowly.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell handcuff/stash only for now.
items.opportunity: Collins route monopoly; Dell limited return.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 career games.
items.why: Clear route lead post-Rice but historical ceiling limited.
items.implication: Volume without proven efficiency; volatile WR3/flex.
items.conflict: High routes but low historical yardage ceiling.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity per Levitan after ETR watch list.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8; Tracy also hamstring.
